mapper.select: select id, source_entity_id, url, endpoint_type, polling_interval_seconds, status, config::text as config_json, next_fetch_at from source.source_endpoint where status = 'ACTIVE' and endpoint_type in ('RSS', 'ATOM') and (next_fetch_at is null or next_fetch_at <= now()) order by next_fetch_at nulls first, id for update skip locked limit #{limit}
select id, source_entity_id, url, endpoint_type, polling_interval_seconds, status, config::text as config_json, next_fetch_at from source.source_endpoint where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update source.source_endpoint set next_fetch_at = #{nextFetchAt}, last_fetch_job_id = #{jobId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{endpointId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select j.id, j.endpoint_id, e.name as endpoint_name, s.name as source_name, j.trigger_type, j.idempotency_key, j.status, j.attempt_count, j.max_attempts, j.http_status, j.artifact_count, j.discovered_count, j.new_entry_count, j.error_code, j.last_error, j.correlation_id, j.trace_id, j.replay_of_job_id, j.started_at, j.finished_at, j.created_at, j.updated_at from source.fetch_job j join source.source_endpoint e on e.id = j.endpoint_id join source.source_entity s on s.id = e.source_entity_id j.status = #{status} order by j.created_at desc, j.id desc limit #{limit}

select j.id, j.endpoint_id, e.name as endpoint_name, s.name as source_name, j.trigger_type, j.idempotency_key, j.status, j.attempt_count, j.max_attempts, j.http_status, j.artifact_count, j.discovered_count, j.new_entry_count, j.error_code, j.last_error, j.correlation_id, j.trace_id, j.replay_of_job_id, j.started_at, j.finished_at, j.created_at, j.updated_at from source.fetch_job j join source.source_endpoint e on e.id = j.endpoint_id join source.source_entity s on s.id = e.source_entity_id where j.id = #{id}

select id, original_event_id, queue_name, event_type, idempotency_key, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, failure_count, last_error, replay_status, replayed_by, replay_event_id, first_failed_at, last_failed_at, created_at from messaging.dead_letter_record replay_status = #{status} order by last_failed_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select id, original_event_id, queue_name, event_type, idempotency_key, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, failure_count, last_error, replay_status, replayed_by, replay_event_id, first_failed_at, last_failed_at, created_at from messaging.dead_letter_record where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update source.fetch_job set status = 'QUEUED', attempt_count = 0, error_code = null, last_error = null, started_at = null, finished_at = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'DEAD_LETTERED'
